_meta.claim: Go internal/calendar produces the same Ekadashi dates, Sankranti moments and observance days, eclipse lists, Hindu-calendar coordinates and regional New Year dates as the TypeScript, for the same places and years. The Sankranti `moment` pins the bisection midpoint sequence, which is where a truncating Go integer division would show and nowhere else (docs/porting.md §1.5).
_meta.note: 1912 carries negative epoch milliseconds throughout, which is the only span in which Math.floor((lo+hi)/2) and a truncating (lo+hi)/2 differ. Longyearbyen and Alert exist to reach the three polar guards; guardHits counts each, so a span that stops reaching one fails rather than passing quietly.
